_comment: Weekly lead-in for summary.plain (the grandmother layer). generate.mjs weeklyOpener() compares this week's score to the most recent prior snapshot in historical.json and prepends one of these, ahead of the transition-agnostic monthly 'standing' read, which already names the band. Slots: {score} {max} {prior}, plus {points} for the suspension keys. Suspension keys (2026-10-18, lib/weekly-opener.mjs): on the cycle where the ETF-01 suspension starts, 'suspensionStart' (or 'suspensionStartNoPoints') states the data effect, then 'othersHeld'/'othersUp'/'othersDown' report the other signals against the prior score minus the removed points ({prior} is that comparable figure). Shown only when a genuine prior snapshot exists. Every key must exist in all four locales: generate.mjs throws on a missing one.

moveUp.pt-BR: A pontuação se firmou um pouco nesta semana, de {prior} para {score} de {max}.

moveUp.de: Der Wert festigte sich diese Woche etwas, von {prior} auf {score} von {max}.

suspensionStart.en: From this update, the ETF flow indicator is suspended because its data cannot be verified week by week. Its {points} points no longer count, which is a change in our data, not in the market.
suspensionStart.pt-BR: A partir desta atualização, o indicador de fluxos de ETF está suspenso porque seus dados não podem ser verificados semana a semana. Os {points} pontos dele deixam de contar, o que é uma mudança nos nossos dados, não no mercado.

suspensionStartNoPoints.es: Desde esta actualización, el indicador de flujos de ETF queda suspendido porque sus datos no pueden verificarse semana a semana. No sumaba puntos, así que esto no cambia la puntuación.
suspensionStartNoPoints.de: Ab diesem Update ist der ETF-Fluss-Indikator ausgesetzt, weil sich seine Daten nicht Woche für Woche prüfen lassen. Er brachte keine Punkte, daher ändert das den Wert nicht.
